*[[Barrison Draay]] and [[Krynda Draay|Krynda Hulis]] are [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]].<ref name="KOTOR 33">[[Knights of the Old Republic 33|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 33]]</ref><ref name="KOTOR 33 date">The knighting of Barrison and Krynda Draay takes place ten years before the [[Battle of Toprawa (Great Sith War)|Battle of Toprawa]] according to [[Knights of the Old Republic 33|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 33]]. The following events take place in '''4006 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Barrison Draay]] and [[Krynda Draay|Krynda Hulis]] are [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|promoted]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. [[Haazen]] is denied the rank due to his compromised skills and temperament and ends up serving Draay as his assistant. {{Circa}}.<ref name="KOTOR 33" /><ref name="KOTOR 33 date" />
